test_title: PYST 56: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Amongst seven girls Aanya, Bira, Cleo, Diana, Elle, Fathima and Georgia, each has a different age. Fathima is elder than only Cleo. Bira is younger than only Georgia. Diana is older than four other girls. Aanya is younger than Elle. Who is the fourth eldest among the girls?
solution:
Amongst seven girls Aanya, Bira, Cleo, Diana, Elle, Fathima and Georgia, each has a different age.

1) Bira is younger than only Georgia.

Georgia > Bira

2) Diana is older than four other girls.

Georgia > Bira > Diana >___&am
